request.query: Residence permit for studies (with family members)

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: If your studies in Finland take longer than 90 days you need a residence permit for studies
If you are granted a residence permit for studies, your spouse and children can be granted a residence permit on the basis of family ties
You can submit the application in the online service Enter Finland

sources.title: enterfinland.fi
highlights: This residence permit application is for you if you are coming to Finland to study at a Finnish educational institution at which you have already been accepted as a student
Remember to take a passport photo with you

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: When you apply for a residence permit, you must usually have a valid national passport
In situations other than the ones listed above, you will usually get a negative decision if you submit your application for a first residence permit while in Finland

sources.title: dvv.fi
highlights: A personal identity code is issued to a foreign citizen moving to Finland from abroad after they have been registered in the Population Information System at their own request or at the time they are granted a residence permit

sources.title: enb.fi
highlights: After the decision, producing and posting the residence permit card takes about two more weeks
The most common misunderstanding is that the clock starts the moment you submit
About 82% of positive decisions on first student permits come within 30 days

sources.title: finlandhandbook.com
highlights: Anecdotal evidence suggests checking first thing in the morning (e.g., 8:00 AM EET) or late in the evening can yield results, as these might be when daily allocations are updated or when others cancel
Sometimes, new slots appear for a fleeting moment due to cancellations or system updates

sources.title: finlandforum.org
highlights: Most employees in Finland (including at Migri) are on vacation in July, and student residence permits have priority in summer since teaching starts September 1st
